**LiHua:** Wow, after playing Red Dead Redemption 2, now I can really understand the importance of good NPC design for a game!

This statement by LiHua marks the beginning of a deeper conversation about how non-player characters (NPCs) contribute to storytelling in video games, setting the stage for fellow gamers and experts to share their insights and experiences.

**ThaneChambers:** Totally agree, NPCs add so much depth to games! They can make the world feel alive.

Here, ThaneChambers builds upon LiHua's comment, emphasizing the importance of NPCs in enriching the game world. The dialogue continues to unfold as they exchange stories and preferences related to NPC-driven narratives, highlighting their mutual interest in the role of NPCs within their gaming experiences.
